title: cathedral_validator_roster_v1
description: Validator-signed private roster of verified SEV-SNP machines (cathedral-validator canary 8). Built from the positive machine rows of direct_validator (uid, hotkey, endpoint, machine_id). roster_id = 'sha256:' + hex(sha256(canonical JSON of the document without roster_id and signature)); canonical JSON = json.dumps(doc, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False), no floats. signature = sr25519 by validator.hotkey over b'cathedral-validator-roster-v1\x00' + roster_id (ASCII). POST the canonical bytes to /v1/cathedral/snp/roster with 'Authorization: Bearer <ingest token>' and 'Content-Type: application/json'. The API refuses: an unpinned validator hotkey, another network/netuid, generated_at older than its intake window or more than 60 s ahead, a sequence not greater than the last accepted one for that validator, a repeated roster_id, rows out of order, a repeated machine_id or endpoint, more than 256 rows or more than 262144 bytes.

network.description: finney with netuid 94 (mainnet) or test with netuid 584 (testnet).

hotkey.description: The signing validator hotkey; must be pinned in CATHEDRAL_SNP_JOIN_VALIDATOR_HOTKEYS.

sequence.description: Strictly increasing per validator hotkey across posts (for example the export counter persisted beside the telemetry export state).

block.description: Chain block of the scoring round the rows come from.

rows.description: Positive (paid) machine rows of this round, sorted by (uid, machine_id, endpoint); machine_id and endpoint each unique. An empty list is valid.

endpoint.description: The miner's verified axon origin: explicit HTTPS origin on a public IP literal (validate_public_worker_endpoint). The API looks for the customer guest on the same IP at port 8444.

machine_id.description: snp_production._machine_id: hex(sha256(b'cathedral.amd-sev-snp.hardware-v1\x00' + generation + b'\x00' + CHIP_ID)), generation in milan/genoa/turin from the verified report.

value_base64.description: Standard base64 (with padding) of the 64-byte signature.
